text: Orcish War Machines are the demolishers the Horde have brought in their attempt to take the Headlands in Gilneas. They can be found hurling flaming balls of pitch at the s the night elves have brought to defend the lands.
Orc Raiders are orcs part of the Horde ground forces assaulting the Headlands in Gilneas.

Orc Survivors are orc survivors of the wrecked ship, Draka's Fury, sunk by the Alliance off the coast of the Lost Isles. The survivors are initially encountered by goblin players at the Horde Base Camp, and then later at various locations on the Isles.
Orc Scouts can be found on the Lost Isles, first encountered serving beside at the Vicious Vale.
This map contains many of the points of interest within Orgrimmar.
Orgrimmar Defenders were orc grunts once located just inside Ragefire Chasm.

Orchid Hollow is a glade found immediately to the southwest of the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. Besides a few frogs and snakes, nothing roams here. Shadybranch Pocket is to the north, Fox Grove is to the southwest, and Serpent's Heart is to the northwest.
Ordo Overseers are yaungol located in Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit. They are controlling Farmstead Slaves.
Ordo Marauders are yaungol located in Fire Camp Ordo in Kun-Lai Summit.
__NOTOC__ Ordo Warriors are yaungol located in Fire Camp Ordo in Kun-Lai Summit.
Ordo Battleyaks are yaks located at Fire Camp Ordo in Kun-Lai Summit.
__NOTOC__ Ordo Warbringer is yaungol found at Fire Camp Ordo in Kun-Lai Summit. He is the leader of the Ordo tribe.
Orchard Wasps are wasps located at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
Orc Overseers are orcs that can be found at Bathran's Haunt in Ashenvale. They oversee the work of the Forsaken Herbalists wandering the area.
Orendil's Apprentices are night elves located at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.

Orgrimmar Braves are tauren guards tasked with protecting the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. After the death of Vol'jin, several braves commented on the recent events. They appear in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
The Orgrimmar Orphanage is located in the first level of The Drag. During Children's Week members of the Horde can pick up quests from the Orphan Matron.

The Order of the Cloud Serpent Tabard is sold by San Redscale in the Jade Forest after reaching with the Order of the Cloud Serpent for .

Orchard Tools are hoes and rakes that can be found littering the ground of Nectarbreeze Orchard in the Jade Forest. They are required in Orchard-Supplied Hardware for the farmers to fight better against the invasion.
__NOTOC__ Orgus is an ogre located at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is being held in a tower as a temporary prison.

Oregrind's Dig is the entrance area to Daxil's Dig on the western shores of Bilgewater Beach in Krasarang Wilds. Grezik Oregrind is found near the entrance here, while Daxil "The Gem" Oregrind is found near the tents.
Orchard Keeper Li Mei is a level 85 herbalism trainer located in Paw'don Village in Jade Forest.
Orgrimmar Citizens were orcs located in Orgrimmar and Durotar during the Elemental Unrest. They were being recruited for the Twilight's Hammer.
Orgrimmar Mages were orc mages located in Orgrimmar during the Elemental Unrest. They predated the playable orc mages.
Ordos is a world boss found on the Timeless Isle. He may only be accessed by players who own one of the legendary cloaks, obtainable before the release of Warlords of Draenor.
Oriana is a pandaren located at the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle. She has a pet named Allie.
Ordon Candlekeepers are yaungol located at Firewalker Ruins on the Timeless Isle.
Ordon Oathguards are yaungol located in the Firewalker Ruins on the Timeless Isle.
Ordon Fire-Watchers are yaungol located in the Firewalker Ruins on the Timeless Isle.

Orgrimmar Wind Riders are mounted orc guards found protecting the skies of Orgrimmar atop their wyverns. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore they were preparing their mounts at the Dranosh'ar Blockade, many of them accompanied the orc fleet alongside Darkspear Bat Riders. Most of the wind riders did not survive. During the Legion Invasions, contingents of them were sent to defend Azshara and the Northern Barrens. Prior to the Burning of Teldrassil, they were once again seen preparing at the Dranosh'ar Blockade. They guarded Orgrimmar during the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar.
The Ordon Death Chime drops from Flintlord Gairan, a rare elite yaungol on the western side of Ordon Sanctuary on Timeless Isle.

Crates of Ordon Supplies are found all over the Ordon yaungol territories of Firewalker Ruins and Shrine of the Black Flame on Timeless Isle. They contain a few Timeless Coins and may contain a Zen-level elixir.
Ordos Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating on the Timeless Isle in a raid with at least 8 guild members.

The Ordon are a large warlike tribe of yaungol found on the Timeless Isle. While the yaungol as a race are usually associated with fire, the Ordon base their entire culture around it. The Ordon worship and are led by Ordos, a yaungol shaman who sacrificed himself to the flame to become a demigod. As a threat to Pandaria, they are opposed by the recently awoken Emperor Shaohao and his allies. They offer rewards such as the Reins of the Ashhide Mushan Beast to those who would kill their enemies (AKA, everyone else).
Orgrimmar Refugees are orcs from Orgrimmar that have either be pushed out or left on their own and now find themselves in the Razor Hill Outskirts.
Orc Children were orcs from Orgrimmar that have either be pushed out or left on their parents and now find themselves in the Razor Hill Outskirts during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Orgrimmar Faithfuls are orcs seen during the Nazgrim encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Orebender Gor'ashan is the first boss in Upper Blackrock Spire.

The Order of the Awakened are an arakkoa faction comprised of both cursed and high arakkoa. The Order gathers Apexis Crystals to bring a new and brighter future for their people. The Arakkoa Outcasts are vexed by them, due to the crimes high arakkoa in general have committed against cursed arakkoa. Nevertheless, the Outcasts hope that the Order will be true to their words, and have taken a wait-and-see stance with the faction. The Order of the Awakened was not formed until after the Spires of Arak storyline and is a product of the adventurer's actions. Members of the order can be found at Stormshield and Warspear in Ashran, trading goods in exchange for the crystals. When both the and former
__NOTOC__ Orian Sylvanleaf is a blood elf located at Deathweb Hollow in Talador.
Orcish Signaling Horn is found at beneath a wrecked cart along the road west of Skyreach in northwestern Spires of Arak. It contains ... and 10-20 Garrison Resources.

The Ordo are a tribe of yaungol that were forced out of their homes, and migrated to Kun-Lai Summit as a result. They have taken to attacking nearby settlements from Fire Camp Ordo, such as the Chow Farmstead, taking supplies and the local pandaren as slaves. They stock firebombs among their weapons, and like many yaungol, are harvesting oil at their fire camp. Their leader is protected by four channelers.

Oreo is a pug found aboard the boat The Dimension north of Temple of Karabor in .
Oregorger is one of the bosses of the Slagworks in Blackrock Foundry.

The Order of the Awakened Battle Standard is a Battle Standard that can be purchased from Dawn-Seeker Krisek in Tanaan Jungle for , requiring at least reputation with the Order of the Awakened to purchase.

The Order of the Broken Temple is the order of monks succeeding the order based out of the Peak of Serenity in Pandaria. After the Burning Legion's assault on the Peak and the subsequent death of Grand Master Hight, the survivors rallied on the Wandering Isle, which happened to be nearby when the Legion attacked. Setting up their order hall within the Temple of Five Dawns, they now fight the Legion alongside the other class orders during the demons' third invasion. After the Fourth War, the Order of the Broken Temple makes its appearance in the monk section of the Training Hall in Stormwind and the Barracks in Orgrimmar, with Juisheng Halfclaw, Katrina Long, and Huinli Wingpaw as monk traine

Orgrimmar Portal Stone was provided for Legion: The Legion Returns (Horde) prior Shadowlands.
Order Resources Cache is sold by Illnea Bloodthorn in Dalaran for 1 Blood of Sargeras.
The Ore-Choked Heart is mined from Felslate creatures in the Broken Isles.
The Ore-Bound Eye is mined from Felslate creatures in the Broken Isles.
Orgrimmar Shaman are shaman of the Horde located at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.
Org'mok's Beast is a fel beast that carries Commander Org'mok around the Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle. After the beast is killed, Org'mok dismounts and becomes killable.
Orgrimmar Elite Shieldguards are orcs taking part in the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort during the world event in Silithus.
Orgrimmar Elite Infantrymen were orcs taking part in the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort during the world event in Silithus.

The Orgrimmar Interceptor is a man-sized Horde gunship mount offered as a reward for purchasing a BlizzCon 2017 ticket. Upon logging in, you should receive a message above the Collections button in the Micro Menu indicating that you have an unopened gift in the Mounts tab. Alternatively, you can check your mailbox if it is not showing in the tab.
Orc Death Knights were orcs located in Spires of Arak and Gorgrond. They were taken out by the followers sent from the Lunarfall garrison.

The Orc Statue is the iconic sculpture found at Blizzard's headquarters in , . It was created in 2007. When visitors pass through the gates of the office campus, they immediately gravitate toward the Orc statue. A dear hero in Blizzard's heart, it is a popular spot for meeting people ("Let's meet at the Orc statue!"), [https://www.facebook.com/pg/Blizzard/photos/?ref=page_internal posts on social media], symbolic events (passionate founder speeches often take place in front of the Orc), holiday community projects, and 1 trillion photos and selfies (actually only a billion).
Orgrimmar's Reach is a placable tent that provides a stat bonus if rested in.

Order Advancement (also referred to as Class Hall Upgrades, Order Advancement Tree, and Class Advancement) is the Class Hall upgrades user interface. They mostly serve as bonuses for Class Hall followers, missions, and to obtain specialty items. The main currency is Order Resources.

Orgrimmar Raiders are orcs located in Nazj'vel in Darkshore during the stalemate phase of the War of the Thorns fighting with the dark rangers against the Darkshore Sentinels and Darnassian Archers. Their bodies can be found scattered in the Ruins of Auberdine.
Orgrimmar Medics are orcs located on the Gates of Orgrimmar in Orgrimmar. They are treating the Wounded Horde Soldiers from the Battle for Lordaeron.

Organic Discombobulation Grenade is created by using Kul Tiran and Zandalari Engineering; taught by the Kul Tiran and Zandalari engineering trainers, and for at a skill of (1). Rank 2 is taught by the same trainer for at a skill of (35). Rank 3 is taught by Schematic: Organic Discombobulation Grenade; obtained from World Quest: Work Order: Organic Discombobulation Grenade.
Ordnance Handler Prim can be found in Tiragarde Sound in Kul Tiras.
The Ordinary Pebble is found in Drak'thul's camp in the Broken Shore. It may be difficult to reach, with the orc looming over it. Talk to Drak'thul to make him turn around.
The Order of Embers Commendation is automatically consumed and provides the amount of reputation shown in its tooltip with the Order of Embers.

Orgrimmar Fortresses are buildings appearing in Orgrimmar during To Tame a Land and in Tidefury Cove during Old Hatreds. For the first one, Thrall and Rexxar's stash can be found there. It corresponds to Grommash Hold in the Valley of Wisdom. File:To Tame a Land - Valley of Wisdom and Grommash Hold.jpg|The first Fortres in Orgrimmar. File:Old Hatreds - Tidefury Cove - Orgrimmar Fortress.jpg|The second Orgrimmar Fortress in Tidefury Cove.

The Orgrimmar Hero's War Banner is a toy summoning a Horde banner. It is part of the BlizzCon 2018 virtual rewards, announced and rewarded on September 26, 2018 to those who bought a physical or virtual ticket.
Orgrimmar Watch Towers are watch towers defending the Horde base in Tidefury Cove during Old Hatreds.
The Order of Embers Supplies is a quest reward from Supplies from the Order of Embers.

The Orders from Nazjatar drop from Tidemistress Nazesh in Zuldazar.

Orgrimmar Fireeaters were orcs and jungle trolls located in Orgrimmar. They were replaced by Master Flame Eaters.

Ortor of Murkblood is a Broken found in Nagrand. He is a notable leader in the Murkblood tribe, once a noble shaman and friend of Arechron, Ortor went evil and became a muck-addled yes-man of Swamplord Musel'ek. He led his Murkblood forces to invade the Mag'har fishing town of Sunspring and killed roughly a thousand orcs, taking over the town as a base whilst making plans to attack Telaar. As a result, both Farseer Margadesh of the Mag'har and Arechron of the Kurenai want Ortor's head.

Orithos the Sky Darkener is a skeleton found in Death's Breach in the Scarlet Enclave. It's unknown what happens to him after the events at the Scarlet Enclave.

Orsonn is the son of Ursoc and nephew of Ursol. He can be found at the Rage Fang Shrine in Grizzly Hills. In fact, he is a prisoner of a sort, as the mad furbolgs of the Frostpaw tribe won't allow him to leave, and because he loves his people, he would rather stay put than hurt any of them. After the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard learned from Kodian, his sister, that Orsonn is still present in the shrine to continue his duty, and that both of them still hope that someday their people will find peace among themselves. Ork Reservation was a location from the canceled game Warcraft Adventures. It was one of the internment camps where surviving orcs and their Horde allies were kept after the Horde's defeat in the Second War. The camps were guarded by Alliance troops to ensure that no one escaped, and the prisoners spent their time drinking black ale which was given out every day along with a share of meat. Interestingly, in this version of the story it was not only the orcs that were kept in the camps, but at least their forest troll and ogre allies as well. Oru'kai's Scepter and Oru'kai's Frost Anomaly are found at the south end of the Cracking Plains in east-central Frostfire Ridge. Two Glacier Furies are channeling something into the scepter that has caused it to freeze about 30 creatures around it, including Rangari Scouts, Adolescent Snow Lurkers, Thunderlord Shaman, Wor'gol Explorers, Frost Wolves, Thunderlord Crag-Leapers, and Torag Stonefury.

Oskiira the Vengeful is found just south of Talon Altar in Spires of Arak. Behind Oskiira lies a nest of broken eggs, around the nest lies the remains of a dread raven and three Sethekk Chosen. The first time killed, Oskiira will drop Oskiira's Mercy and 20-30 Garrison Resources. While seemingly a ghost, Oskiira is currently of the beast type.

The Orunai Bay is a large bay just off the Orunai Coast in Talador. The docks of Sha'tari Anchorage, Beacon of Sha'tar, and Shattrath Port Authority are found in this bay, which eventually merges into the .
